articles.title: Museums On The Move
articles.summary: A recent report highlights the critical need for Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises (MSMEs) to enhance their digital infrastructure. This is vital for improving operational efficiency, fostering sustainable growth, and boosting competitiveness within the national economy. Strengthening digital capabilities will enable MSMEs to contribute more effectively to overall economic development and national progress.

articles.title: French WWII Blockbuster ‘De Gaulle’ Lands U.S. Distribution With Samuel Goldwyn Films (EXCLUSIVE)
articles.summary: Samuel Goldwyn Films has acquired U.S. distribution rights for 'De Gaulle,' Antonin Baudry's two-part historical epic. Premiering at Cannes, the film explores the life of Charles de Gaulle, France's pivotal wartime leader and statesman. This acquisition brings the critically acclaimed French production, detailing a significant international historical figure, to American audiences, offering insights into crucial European history relevant for broader general knowledge.

articles.title: Modi raises safety of Indians in Black Sea in talks with Putin, nudges Russian leader to end Ukraine conflict
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi recently discussed the safety of Indian seafarers in the Black Sea with Russian President Vladimir Putin. Amidst ongoing regional instability, PM Modi reiterated India's strong commitment to supporting any peace initiative to resolve the conflict. This diplomatic engagement underscores India's efforts to ensure its citizens' security while advocating for de-escalation in international conflict zones affecting global maritime routes.

articles.title: In talks with Putin, Modi raises safety of Indians in Black Sea
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi engaged with Russian President Putin to address the safety of Indian seafarers in the Black Sea, a region impacted by ongoing conflict. Modi underscored India's deep concern for its citizens' welfare abroad and reiterated India's unwavering commitment to supporting peace initiatives. This diplomatic outreach highlights India's active role in global affairs and its dedication to safeguarding its diaspora amidst international complexities.
